searchText: Yes I don't know why it spits out blocks every 15 <@489256758989029405> you said "In sync" earlier...? yes, we managed to get all the blocks synced The fast sync issue is fixed. Don't know what happened, the sealer refused to deliver the state root, but when I shut it down it happily saved it to disk, and delivered after restart. Also, syncmode=snap works too I still have an issue w/ `syncmode=snap` where it seems like the states are never pulled: ``` > eth.syncing { currentBlock: 11838, highestBlock: 11903, knownStates: 0, pulledStates: 0, startingBlock: 9851 } ``` even though new headers are imported fine as they come in. confirmed fast sync is working for me though (and full sync continues to work) also I mentioned this in the PR but jsut in case you didn't see I'm also seeing that the `from` field in `eth_getTransactionReceipt` is always `0x00...` for EIP-2930 txs. I'm guessing maybe the EC recover is failing? Perhaps the receipt recovery hasn't been updated yet? Not sure we update the state counter for snap... Snap works differently. Dp you import headers or blocks? Yeah I know we have receipt rpc issues
